ns2:section.sectionText: 1st-8 weeks. ILLINI “Get your kicks on Route 66” Develop networking skills, with RST industry alumni & professionals while exploring Illinois via the “Mother Road”. Best practices and current issues will be explored, with an emphasis on tourism trends and the history & legends that made them iconic. Site visits include The Gateway Arch, Litchfield Route 66 District, Springfield Legislative Campus, Abraham Lincoln Presidential Library and Museum, Lincoln Tomb State Historic Site, Funk Grove Maple Syrup Farm, and the Abraham Lincoln National Cemetery. Tour scheduled for Feb 28 – March 2. Orientation and wrap up meetings scheduled for Feb 10, Feb 24, March 10 at 4PM. A $160 course fee will cover transportation, hotel, and meal, etc. Please contact Michael Raycraft (mraycraf@illinois.edu) for further information.
